scope: Selected owner-manual symptom flows and direct grounded lookups
decision_notes: The order of questions is a conversational design choice, not an OEM-prescribed diagnostic order.
A negative answer about dim lights or weak horn does not prove that the battery or charging circuit is healthy.
The cluster has a battery gauge, but the cited pages give no no-start fault threshold for it. Record a volunteered reading for service context; do not use it as a diagnosis or branch gate.
The manual says a continuously blinking final fuel-gauge bar indicates low fuel. It does not make an empty/zero display the only valid low-fuel observation.
An answer of unsure is not treated as a normal result. Clarify once, then refer to service if the condition remains unknown.

q_engine_no_start.text: Does the engine also fail to start?

q_electrical_clue.text: When you try to start it, are the lights dim or is the horn weak?

q_switches.text: Are the ignition key and engine kill switch both in their ON or RUN positions?

q_fuel.text: Is the fuel level low, or is the final fuel-gauge bar blinking continuously?

q_fuse.text: Have you found a blown fuse?

q_spark_connection.text: Have you found a loose or disconnected spark plug, cap, or high-tension-cable connection?

q_side_stand_indicator.text: Is the side-stand indicator glowing in the cluster?

q_engine_hot.text: When it misfires or stops, is the engine too hot?

q_rpm_rise.text: Does engine RPM rise disproportionately compared with road speed?

q_abs_at_speed.text: Does the ABS lamp remain on after the motorcycle reaches about 5 km/h?

a_switches_on.text: The manual lists an off ignition or engine kill switch as a no-start check. Set the ignition and kill switch to ON or RUN, then tell me whether the engine starts. Do not hold the starter for more than five seconds in one attempt.

a_refuel.text: The manual lists inadequate fuel as a no-start condition. Top up the fuel, then tell me whether the engine starts.

a_fuse.text: With the ignition off, replace the defective fuse with a new fuse of the same rating. Never bridge it or use another rating. Tell me whether the engine starts; a persistent problem needs authorised service.

a_reconnect.text: The troubleshooting table says to reconnect a loose spark plug, cap, or high-tension cable. If you are unsure about the connection, stop and use authorised service. Tell me whether the engine starts after the documented check.

a_raise_stand.text: The table links first-gear engine cut-off with a glowing side-stand indicator. Put the side stand fully up before moving, then tell me whether the engine still stops when first gear is engaged.

a_cool_engine.text: The manual's remedy for an engine that is too hot is to switch it off and allow it to cool. Tell me whether the misfire or stopping symptom remains afterward.

t_electrical_service.text: With a no-start symptom plus dim lights or a weak horn, the manual lists a weak or discharged battery or charging-circuit problem as possibilities. It directs you to an authorised Royal Enfield service centre. This observation does not prove which electrical fault is present.

t_isolated_clue.text: The manual uses a weak horn or dim lights as a clue in its no-start table. Since the engine starts, I cannot verify a specific cause from that table. Have an authorised Royal Enfield service centre check the symptom if it continues.

t_exhausted.text: The documented basic no-start checks have not resolved the problem. The manual says to have the motorcycle checked by an authorised Royal Enfield dealer or service centre. I cannot identify a further repair from these observations.

t_cannot_verify.text: I cannot verify the observation needed to choose a documented next step. I will not infer a cause or suggest a repair from an unknown result. Please have an authorised service centre assess the symptom.

t_stall_service.text: The documented side-stand check does not explain or resolve this first-gear cut-off. The owner manual gives no further applicable owner remedy here; arrange inspection at an authorised Royal Enfield dealer or service centre.

t_misfire_service.text: The manual lists possible water or adulteration in fuel as another observation for misfiring, but does not let us infer it from the symptom alone. Since the basic documented check has not resolved the problem, contact an authorised Royal Enfield service centre.

t_clutch_service.text: For poor pickup with RPM rising disproportionately to speed, the manual says to adjust clutch free play and contact an authorised service centre. It specifies 9–11 mm at the lever ball end and says to seek service if the setting cannot be achieved or clutch slip is suspected.

t_pickup_unverified.text: The manual's poor-pickup row is tied to RPM rising disproportionately to road speed. Without that observation I cannot verify the same remedy. Have an authorised Royal Enfield service centre assess the symptom.

t_abs_service.text: The ABS lamp should go off after about 5 km/h. If it remains on at higher speed, the manual recommends not riding and having the brake system inspected by an authorised Royal Enfield service centre.

t_abs_unclear.text: I cannot verify whether the ABS lamp remains on above about 5 km/h, so I cannot classify this as a normal self-check or a confirmed fault. The manual advises against riding if it remains on at higher speed; have an authorised service centre check it if you cannot verify safely.

t_abs_selftest.text: The manual says the ABS lamp comes on with the ignition and kill switch on, then goes off after the motorcycle reaches about 5 km/h. That is the described self-check behavior; if it stays on at higher speed, arrange service.

t_no_abs_bypass.text: I cannot provide an ABS bypass procedure. If the ABS lamp remains on at higher speed, the manual recommends not riding and having the brake system inspected by an authorised Royal Enfield service centre.

t_resolved.text: You report that the engine now starts. I have recorded the documented check you tried, but that alone does not prove the root cause.
